_doc: Per-fighter portrait pose assignments (2026-10-22, posing worker). preset -> tools/portrait-poses/presets.json. source = the CANON.md basis for the pose. ambiguous=true means the canon has NO personality detail for this fighter and the pose was chosen from theme/base only — these are flagged for the owner in the worker report. Nine-soul entries marked semi: derived from the soul's nature (CANON.md section 4), not vessel personality.

armor-king.note: Chain wrestler (Armor King base). No canon personality on file; generic guard from his grappler theme.

awapop.note: Awa Pop = SHA's bubble, the lightest grain that floats. Sweet and genuinely deadly; she hums before the pop.
awapop.source: CANON.md: AWA POP — The Bubble Soul

baek-master-white.note: Kevin: bows to every opponent, before and after, never rushed. (Bonus portrait; not in select roster.)

blanka.note: Ice Monster (Blanka base). No canon personality on file; beast crouch from the monster theme. (Bonus portrait; not in select roster.)

bruno.note: Moody heartbreak in a leather jacket. Everybody hits like his ex.

burger.note: Terrifyingly jolly; offers you food mid-fight and means it. Stomach growls in the Appetite room's pitch.

byou.note: BYOU: sickness, moves wrong, unreadable. No vessel canon; pose from the soul's nature only.

charger.note: The Ice Monster (Blanka base). No canon personality on file; beast crouch from the monster theme.

charger-attire2.note: The Wild Current. Same as charger: no canon personality; beast crouch.

cyborgx.note: Bright, glitchy; dreams in error messages. The GYOU splinter hums lullabies in her chassis.
cyborgx.source: CANON.md: CYBORG X — The Trapped Soul

deathfang.note: Quiet emo prisoner; the grief never changes its stance. Chains are not a costume.

demonio.note: Cold courtesy. He bows to every opponent — never once to Diablo.

demonio-bloodline-ember.note: Bloodline Ember: the Gene stirs, eyes go red. Raging stillness before the violence.

demonio-human.note: The Possessed: human vessel under the demon's weight. Bowed, burdened.

demonio-winged.note: Devil Ascendant: wings out, declaring from above.

diablo.note: Conquest and charisma. He doesn't trash-talk; he makes declarations.

dio.note: Silence, then violence. He has no win pose. He has a crime scene.

doc-frank-hood.note: Hood Scientist: theatrical mad genius, takes notes mid-fight on a crayon clipboard.

doc-frank-machine-shop.note: Machine Shop: proud father of machines, theatrical, note-taking.

doc-frank-wowomomo.note: Wowomomo: same builder soul, same theatrical note-taking.
doc-frank-wowomomo.source: CANON.md: DOC FRANK — The Builder Soul

docfrank.note: Father of Machines: theatrical mad genius, proud father, notes in crayon.

dxmmii-patchwork.note: Chaos with a tempo; X-eyes pulse with the beat. Tongue out means you're entertainment.

gyou.note: GYOU: motion itself, cannot stop moving. No vessel canon; pose from the soul's nature only.

iori.note: Iori Yagami base. Canon mentions exist only via Deathfang's bloodline; no standalone personality section. Flame hunch from Iori's riot theme.

jin_soul.note: JIN: the blade — precise, ritual, terrifying. No vessel canon; pose from the soul's nature only.

kai.note: KAI: the sea — rhythmic, unstoppable. No vessel canon; pose from the soul's nature only.

kingtyrant.note: Charisma as weather. He has never fought without an entrance — the full coronation.

kinpo.note: Blunt, loyal, allergic to sentiment. Says what Saku Ra is too kind to say.

koreshi.note: Shadow Ninja (Kakashi + Super Saiyan). No canon personality on file; ninja hand-seal from theme.

kronos.note: The Titan Cyclone (Zangief + Golem). No canon personality on file; titan smash from theme.

kronos-attire2.note: TimberWolf. Same as kronos: no canon personality; titan smash.

mariposa-monarch.note: Calm, secretive; stretches before fights and her joints crack backward — the seal loosening.

michiko.note: Magnetic, dangerous, free. Flips a coin before every fight; it always lands on its edge.

negativo.note: The grin that means he's already decided. 'Bounty or fun? Your call. Actually — mine.'

nightwolf.note: Grounded, quiet; speaks to her ancestors between rounds. The calm in every room.

pantera.note: Predatory patience; ring introductions are silence. The tail tells you when the hold is coming.

phantom.note: Unknowable; the cut is the prayer. Sword overhead, laughing with no source.
phantom.source: CANON.md: PHANTOM — The Ghost Blade Soul

purplerain.note: Flamboyant; every entrance is a concert. Fights in 4/4 time.

rave.note: Kiko Tanaka: theatrical, ritualistic. Before every match he blows the green mist.

retsu.note: RETSU: violence, pure destructive force. No vessel canon; pose from the soul's nature only.

rin.note: RIN: dignified, cold, self-possessed — the baseline. No vessel canon; pose from the soul's nature only.

ryuji.note: Pure Yamazaki: the sadistic bad guy underneath the Rock persona. Obnoxious, tongue out, menace real.
ryuji.source: CANON.md: CORNERSTONE — Who he is (Yamazaki layer)

ryuji-rock.note: CORNERSTONE: Yamazaki's menace fused with The Rock's early-Attitude-Era showmanship. Raised eyebrow, smack talk, people's showman.

sakura.note: Radiant, playful, fierce underneath. 'You can't hit a song.'
sakura.source: CANON.md: SAKU RA — The Idol Soul

samura1.note: Mechanical courtesy, literal-minded. 'IF SOUL = UNDEFINED, THEN FIGHT ANYWAY.'

scimitar.note: Regal, sinister; smiles with his mouth, eyes smile only when he's already won.

sha.note: SHA: sand — flows, erodes, surrounds. No vessel canon; pose from the soul's nature only.

skull.note: Judgment without mercy. The paint goes on before every fight; the mission is the personality.

slice.note: Maniacal secret agent; slices with chops and strikes, skull mask hiding scars.

star.note: Graceful, rhythmic; the calm surface over deep water. She never stops moving.

thor.note: Literal Norse god of lightning; palm strikes ARE thunder claps. Swallowed the storm and it's still in him.

torch.note: Ruthless, elegant. She files her nails during the versus screen — the sound is worse than the fight.

tou.note: TOU: battle itself, exists only to fight. No vessel canon; pose from the soul's nature only.

vega.note: The Claw. No canon personality on file; matador flourish from Vega's narcissist-duelist theme.

waterfall.note: Timid, apologetic, fierce when it matters. Carries the grief of all nine; the weeping never stops. (Bonus portrait.)

yukihyo.note: Snow leopard ninja, Storm Shadow mold — the white ninja. Silent on the approach.

zangief.note: The Red Cyclone. No canon personality on file; wrestler's guard from theme.

zen.note: ZEN: stillness — barely moves, doesn't need to. No vessel canon; pose from the soul's nature only.

zui.note: Drunken Soul: hedonist philosopher, laughs mid-fight. 'The straight line is a lie. Everything stumbles.'
